title: DOSE-10060 receipt profile on RCO-10060
description: How a cleared read of a DOSE-10060 record is receipted. The receipt object is RCO-10060 receipt v1, unchanged; this profile fixes what each field carries for a medicine read. Version 1.0, 2026-11-14.

receipt_v1_fields.writer: The Dosidal door that served the read
receipt_v1_fields.caller: The resolved agent identity; 'public' for an open read
receipt_v1_fields.subject: The record's subject id
receipt_v1_fields.market: The market the record was read under
receipt_v1_fields.rule_version: standard_version + instance_version + the access rule applied, joined in that order
receipt_v1_fields.answer_hash: SHA-256 of the canonicalised signed record supplied. The only link between receipt and record.
receipt_v1_fields.prev_hash: Hash of the previous receipt in the chain

rules: The receipt key and the record key are different keys. Neither signs the other's object.
An as-of read is receipted with the as_of date inside the hashed record, so the receipt binds to the historical answer.
A refused read is receipted too, with the refusal as the answer.
Verifying a receipt needs no credential.
